title: Pokemon TCG Espathra Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift 081/182 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after HOLO Espartha 081/182 NM / M - RARE Paradox Rift Pokemon Card is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. With its stunning holo finish and beautiful artwork, this card is sure to impress.

Featuring the psychic type and stage 1 evolution, this card is a powerful addition to any deck. Its rarity and unique design make it a valuable find for collectors, while its quality and manufacturing by Nintendo ensure its longevity. Don't miss out on the chance to add this rare card to your collection today.
